integrity: Standalone standard-library verification covers 13 explicitly enumerated graph/color pairs and exact formal checks through parameter 80. The mathematical proof establishes the all-order theorem; independent audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Complete classification for equal independent doublets and cyclic parameters at least three only. No claim for unequal or larger layers, no estimates for the negative roots, and no guarantee of historical priority against incompletely accessible older literature.
title: Parity determines every real dichromatic root of cyclic doublet digraphs
